projects.title: Best Projects
projects.amber: An upcoming Apple Music client that will change the way you view and interact with music.

interests.title: Interests
interests.codingBody: In 2021, I started making Discord bots in JavaScript using discord.js, then I made a few websites in native HTML, CSS and JavaScript. After making websites, I made a few Minecraft Fabric mods in Java and I started making iOS apps using SwiftUI in 2022. I am heavily interested in iOS development & web dev... Most of these projects can be found on my GitHub profile.
interests.musicBody:
I often compare music to my day-to-day life support. I've been listening to many different genres of music since 2018, and lately I've been mainly focused on rock and alternative music with a little bit of US rap.

Also, recently, I started buying vinyl of albums while listing them on my Discogs account and on the vinyl tab of this site which also includes my wish list for future vinyl.
interests.editingBody:
For a few of my projects, I produce trailer videos which depict main features or newly added features. I make them using Adobe After Effects and/or with Final Cut Pro, while syncing a copyrighted song that are available in this playlist.

They always end up on YouTube, sometimes on 𝕏 (Twitter), sometimes they end up as TikToks. But they're always available.

frosted_money.description: (September 20th, 2024) Fraca releases with full Toronto-only money conversions and tax calculator, as well as the old exchange rate graph, which goes out of its bounds
